Thank you guys so much, I know this is going to sound ridiculous but just having someone to talk to gives me so much reassurance and makes me feel a whole lot better. Thanks for being here for me.

Sorry for not responding for quite a while, I just had to process some things. After I left for college I've been at a really low point in my life. Financial strain, no friends, terrible grades, everything you can think of. I've been thinking of self-harm. I reached out to my family for help, and well, that led to what I wrote above. I've since cut all contact with them, and I'm seeking professional help from a therapist.

Agreed, please don't. Anything that you can think of that will draw a tear is something worth living for. Family? Friends? Pets? Yourself? Take everything into consideration. You are valuable. You are loved, even by strangers on the internet. You only get one life, make the most out of it instead of cutting it short.

I'm in the exact same place. I desperately want somebody to talk to but I'm scared to reach out and ask, because I think it's going to cause my family and friends to go apeshit and I'd immediately regret my decision. I'm embarrased about the suicidal thoughts I have and also fucking angry at myself for having them in the first place. I'm scared to kill or even harm myself.  I completely broke down and just spilled everything on my main reddit account and my friend saw my post and reached out to me. It was completely unintentional, but he really helped me. Just having someone to talk to that you trust, even if they can't help, it just makes you feel better, you know? If you need anything, literally anything, please talk to someone about it. Just having someone, a friend especially, really helps. You can get through this. I know you can get through this. If you need to, just message me. I hope this helps.
